claim: Alt ROM space is finite: call shared latch routines instead of inline macros when full, move state-page-only code to RAM, and check the size after every assemble.

evidence.text: With a full alt ROM one latch routine pair is called instead of the macros inline (25 bytes against 38 for two sites); the alt ROM had 36 bytes left (now 0x3CF9 of 0x3D00).
evidence.quote: routines, not the macros inline: the alt ROM had 36 bytes left (now 0x3CF9 of 0x3D00).

evidence.text: Alt ROM block ends at 0x3CFF with 1 byte left; the 13 bytes of a latched speed exit would end 12 bytes into the ROM font at 0x3D00, so the base engine keeps NEXTREG 7,0.
evidence.quote: Alt ROM: 1149 bytes, ends 0x3CFF with the 20-byte register block (1 byte left).

evidence.text: State-page-only code (326 bytes) moved to RAM page 26, so the alt ROM keeps 914 of its 1,150 bytes; check the size after every assemble.
evidence.quote: the ROM keeps 914 bytes. Check the size after every assemble.
